title: BREAKING: Strikepoint Acquires Massive Gold Deposit From Newmont
speaker: Mike Allen (CEO, StrikePoint Gold), interviewed by Jay Martin

macro_themes.view: Majors like Newmont are shedding non-core Nevada assets that juniors can re-rate, as with Talisman/Coffee and Waterton/Rosebud.

calls.reason: Buying Newmont's Northumberland, Nevada (2.57Moz indicated + 1.72Moz inferred, possible 8-10Moz) for $70M cash; accretive C$2 post-10:1 consolidation financing, drilling from October with results ~December, PEA early 2028; peers re-rated 2-6x.
calls.quote: I think that the shareholders of of existing Straight Point should be happy. We're doing an accretive financing. We're getting a fantastic asset.

notes: Company-promotional CEO interview; host Jay Martin is a disclosed shareholder. No date in transcript; listing approx_date used, but content implies recording ~early August 2026 (deal closing 'mid-September' in ~6 weeks, drilling 'October'). Ticker SKP from general knowledge, not stated in video. $2 is the post-consolidation financing price, not a market quote, so price_at_call left null. No gold price view given.
